claim_boundary: The frontier assumes a single deterministic message followed by a message-indexed nonadaptive set of at most q ideal queries, perfect completeness, and perfect soundness on the zero-marker input. Shared randomness, interaction, bounded error, adaptive queries, or structured side information can change the tradeoff and require new lower bounds.

theorem.attainment: partition N marker indices into q-sized query blocks
theorem.honest_search: N black-box queries before the message can be formed
theorem.interface: one prover message selects at most q ideal semantic queries
